text:
sophie: partner asked if Redwood can emit both per-minute and rolled hourly ledger rows for SI reconciliation. they get per-minute events and want deterministic mapping.
amir: we currently canonicalize to UTC and use half-open hours [H,H+1). minute events with ts >= hour_start && ts < hour_end go to that hour. that should be documented.
sophie: SI wants a predictable rule for events exactly on boundary (e.g., 12:00:00). confirm: we include boundary in the later bucket (>=).
leo: suggest we publish a tiny spec + deterministic reference script that shows mapping rules and de-dupe heuristics. also include how we collapse duplicate idempotency keys across minutes.
marketplace-bot: Task MP-5555 created: publish-minute-to-hour-contract (assignee: leo).
kate: operational note: when backfills arrive we mark affected ledger rows with change_reason=B0_BACKFILL and include original_event_ts and reconciled_at. partners want the change_reason enum documented.
ops: we should include a sample reconciliation CSV that shows before/after rows and a minimal explanation of netting vs incremental rows.
sophie: additional ask: provide a "contract test" endpoint where partners can POST sample minute-events and receive the transformed hourly rows as preview. helpful for SIs to validate.
amir: security: enforce idempotency key canonicalization to 128 bytes, strip whitespace, and lowercase. document that SDKs should compute stable keys.
leo: sample preview response snippet to include in spec: ```json
{"hour":"2026-09-01T12:00:00Z","usage_units":6000,"source":"derived_minute_events","changed_by":"BACKFILL","original_event_count":6020}
```
sophie: action items: leo -> reference script + preview endpoint; amir -> doc boundary rule + idempotency key rules; kate -> change_reason enum and sample CSV; ops -> test harness for partners. i'll coordinate a partner walkthrough next Tue. :white_check_mark:
